correlations.olmo_verdict: The association remains same-signed and at least half as large without OLMo-3, so it is not driven only by OLMo-3.

low_bit_family_size.definition: collapse iff int3 delta loss > 1 nat; size is nominal checkpoint label in billions

score_definition.auc: trapezoidal tested-range AUC; first >1-nat crossing and deeper cells capped at 1 nat
score_definition.cliff: severity of first >1-nat crossing; right-censored at deepest tested point if absent
score_definition.damage: delta capability loss from each method's own dense anchor
score_definition.standardization: within method and capability across 12 models; mean of z(-AUC) and z(cliff survival)
